title: Knowledge
no_entries: No entries in this scope yet
scope_description_hint: What the scope covers (shown to agents)
delete_scope_typed_confirm: Delete the scope “{{name}}” and all {{n}} entries in it? This cannot be undone.
no_scopes_hint: Scopes group reference material by topic, for example Song dynasty daily life.
no_entries_hint: Write the first entry, or let a research task fill this scope.
markdown_hint: Markdown: headings become the context of each chunk.
select_entry_hint: Pick an entry in the middle column to read or edit it.
book_scopes_hint: Agents in this book read every checked scope. New scopes are checked automatically.

research.title: Research
research.list_hint: Gather reference material into a knowledge scope. The researcher works in the scope it is given and saves what it finds there.
research.empty_hint: Create a task to have the researcher collect material on a topic.
research.topic_placeholder: e.g. the layout of tea houses in the Song dynasty
research.defer_all_hint: Postpones every ready task in this list. Resume them one by one when you want them back.
research.deferred_hint: Deferred: this task is skipped until you resume it. It no longer blocks writing.
research.delete_confirm: Delete this research task? Its knowledge entries stay in the scope.
research.no_report: The researcher has not reported yet.
research.scope_not_resolved: The scope is created when the task first runs.
research.blocked_open_session: The task has an open session; finish or stop it before editing.
research.language_book_hint: The task uses the book's language.
research.abandon_confirm: Abandon this research run? The task is cancelled; saved entries stay in the scope.

scope_not_found_hint: Pick another scope on the left, or create a new one.
entry_not_found_hint: It was deleted, or its scope was removed. Pick another entry.
check_focus_placeholder: What should the check focus on?
check_disabled_open: A knowledge check is already open.
scope_creation_hint: A new scope is visible to every book unless that book unchecks it.
